info.title: Quillon Post API
info.description:
Parcel shipping for online shops. Ask for rates, book the parcel, print the label and follow it
to the door; we hand it to one of four carriers and keep the tracking in one shape.

Send your API key as `Authorization: Bearer qp_live_...`. Keys that start with `qp_test_` book
parcels that no van ever collects, and their labels come back marked SAMPLE.

Dates in this API are UTC. Money is in pence, weight in grams, lengths in centimetres.

get.description: No key needed. This is what the load balancer polls.

Quillon-Version.description: The dated version this deployment speaks.

post.summary: Price a parcel with every carrier that will take it
post.description:
Quotes for one parcel, cheapest first, at the price your plan pays.

Quotes are held for half an hour and can be turned into a shipment by id, which is the only
way to be sure the price a shopper saw at the checkout is the price we bill.

post.summary: Book a parcel on to a carrier
post.description:
Books the parcel, reserves a tracking number and puts the label in the queue to print.

Either send a quote_id from /v1/rates/quotes, or name a carrier_code and a service and we
will price it off the card as it stands now.
